title: In-XR Voice, Image Mix & Native Keyboard · v0.7.0
changes: Half-size central XR camera eye, with an ENTER / XR two-line landing portal and clear microphone preflight control.
Native Quest Browser XR system keyboard integration through a focused DOM input; unsupported builds show an in-place warning and never intentionally end the XR session.

Six-second Meta voice transcription uses an already-granted microphone stream. Voice commands such as “where is my backpack?” search saved recognized objects and highlight matching image cards without additional visual inference.
Each source/object card has an X to close it in XR without deleting the saved photograph. Binning a source hides it privately; it can be restored from the Bin.
Optional small mascot pointer, spoken status updates and playful comments; original procedural camera shutter and paper-crumple audio effects.
Private Mix bucket accepts two selected images, including source photographs, and generates a child image with Muse Image only after an explicit Apply action.
An optional in-XR LOG panel shows client API errors and an admin-only bounded server request diagnostic feed (status, path and elapsed time; no request bodies or credentials).
“Improve” is renamed to a restoration instruction: “Restore this image with more detail and a higher resolution,” while preserving the source photograph.
No change to the macOS watcher, cloud/database schema, provider credentials or server billing limits.
